card.title: Act as If It’s True
card.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

mechanism: A asks B to feed a hungry ceiling through concrete choices whose usefulness depends on that impossible premise.
confusable: Unlike asking for verbal agreement, A seeks action and adapts it to B's food and cleanup concerns.
comparison: Inverting a bowl and catching drips differ from reserving and labeling a future visitor's chair.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
